title: A walk through the woods
description: A story lesson. The narrator lives in a very old town surrounded by beautiful woods, a famous beauty spot. On Sundays, hundreds of people come from the city to see the town and to walk through the woods. Visitors have been asked to keep the woods clean and tidy, and litter baskets have been placed under the trees, but people still throw their rubbish everywhere. Last Wednesday, the narrator went for a walk in the woods and was made very sad by what he saw: seven old cars and three old refrigerators, empty litter baskets, and the ground covered with pieces of paper, cigarette ends, old tyres, empty bottles and rusty tins. Among the rubbish he found a sign which said, 'Anyone who leaves litter in these woods will be prosecuted!' The lesson introduces the passive voice with present and past perfect ('have been asked', 'have been placed', 'have been painted'), the relative clauses 'which is surrounded', 'which said', and the noun clause 'What I saw made me very sad'. The workbook drills story comprehension and short answers; the grammar workbook practices giving correct replies with 'I don't need to ... . It/They have already been ...'.
answer_note: The story is from the textbook. Workbook A (comprehension) and B (short answers) are from the workbook answer key (source-key, img/key-141-144.jpg p.218). Grammar I (give correct replies) is from the grammar workbook answer key (source-key, pdf p.578-579).

lesson.text: Listen then answer this question. 听录音，然后回答题目。

A walk through the woods. 林中散步。I live in a very old town which is surrounded by beautiful woods. It is a famous beauty spot. On Sundays, hundreds of people come from the city to see our town and to walk through the woods. Visitors have been asked to keep the woods clean and tidy. Litter baskets have been placed under the trees, but people still throw their rubbish everywhere. Last Wednesday, I went for a walk in the woods. What I saw made me very sad. I counted seven old cars and three old refrigerators. The litter baskets were empty and the ground was covered with pieces of paper, cigarette ends, old tyres, empty bottles and rusty tins. Among the rubbish, I found a sign which said, 'Anyone who leaves litter in these woods will be prosecuted!'
lesson.translation: 林中散步。我住在一个由美丽的树林环绕的古老小镇上。这是一个著名的风景胜地。每逢星期天，有许许多多的人从城里来参观我们的小镇，并在树林中散步。游客已被告知要保持树林的整洁。树下都已设置了废物筐，但是人们仍到处扔垃圾。上星期三我到树林里去散步。我所见到的一切使我非常难过。我数了一下，有7辆旧汽车和3个旧冰箱。废物筐是空的，而满地都是纸片、烟头、旧轮胎、空瓶子和生锈的空罐头盒。在垃圾堆中我发现了一块牌子，上面写着：'凡在此树林里丢弃垃圾者，将依法处置。'

lesson.text: Question: 问题。What was so funny about the words on the sign? 牌子上的字有什么可笑的地方？
lesson.translation: 问题：牌子上的字有什么可笑的地方？

items.meaning: 参观者, 游客, 来访者

items.title: was covered with …
items.text: 「被……覆盖」：the ground was covered with pieces of paper, cigarette ends, old tyres, empty bottles and rusty tins.

items.title: What I saw made me very sad
items.text: 句中的主语 what I saw 是一个以 what 引导的名词性从句。

items.title: I found a sign which said …
items.text: 这里的 said 不当「说」讲，而是「写着……」。

practice.title: Practice A: Comprehension
practice.instruction: Look at the text on Students' Book page 289 and answer these questions. 参见学生用书第 289 页上的课文，然后回答以下问题。
practice.translation: 参见学生用书第 289 页上的课文，然后回答以下问题。
practice.context: 8 comprehension questions about the Lesson 143 story (A walk through the woods).

questions.prompt: What is the writer's old town surrounded by?
questions.answer: It is surrounded by beautiful woods.

questions.prompt: What do hundreds of people do on Sundays?
questions.answer: They come from the city to see the town and to walk through the woods.

questions.prompt: What have visitors been asked to do?
questions.answer: They have been asked to keep the woods clean and tidy.

questions.prompt: Where have litter baskets been placed?
questions.answer: They have been placed under the trees.

questions.prompt: What do people still do?
questions.answer: They still throw their rubbish everywhere.

questions.prompt: What did the writer do last Wednesday?
questions.answer: He went for a walk in the woods.

questions.prompt: Was the ground covered with rubbish?
questions.answer: Yes, it was.

questions.prompt: What did the sign say that he found among the rubbish?
questions.answer: 'Anyone who leaves litter in these woods will be prosecuted!'

practice.title: Practice B: Short answers
practice.instruction: Answer these questions about the text. Agree with them. 用肯定的方式回答有关课文的问题。
practice.translation: 用肯定的方式回答有关课文的问题。
practice.context: 10 short-answer tag questions about the Lesson 143 text; item 1 (The writer lives in a very old town, doesn't he? → Yes, he does.) is the printed example.

questions.prompt: The writer lives in a very old town, doesn't he?
questions.answer: Yes, he does.

questions.prompt: The town is surrounded by beautiful woods, isn't it?
questions.answer: Yes, it is.

questions.prompt: Hundreds of people visit the old town on Sundays, don't they?
questions.answer: Yes, they do.

questions.prompt: They have been asked to keep the wood clean, haven't they?
questions.answer: Yes, they have.

questions.prompt: The litter baskets aren't always used, are they?
questions.answer: No, they aren't.

questions.prompt: What the writer saw in the woods made him sad, didn't it?
questions.answer: Yes, it did.

questions.prompt: People hadn't used the litter baskets, had they?
questions.answer: No, they hadn't.

questions.prompt: The ground wasn't clean, was it?
questions.answer: No, it wasn't.

questions.prompt: It was covered with rubbish, wasn't it?
questions.answer: Yes, it was.

questions.prompt: Anyone who leaves litter will be prosecuted, won't they?
questions.answer: Yes, they will.

grammar.title: Grammar I: Give correct replies according to the example
grammar.instruction: 仿照例句写出下列各句的对应句。
grammar.translation: 仿照例句写出下列各句的对应句。
grammar.key_source: pdf p.578-579 (新概念英语语法练习1)
grammar.context: 10 reply items using 'I don't need to ... . It/They has/have already been ...'; item 1 (Sweep the floor, please. → I don't need to sweep the floor. It has already been swept.) is the printed example.

questions.prompt: Sweep the floor, please.
questions.answer: I don't need to sweep the floor. It has already been swept.

questions.prompt: Clean the cooker, please.
questions.answer: I don't need to clean the cooker. It has already been cleaned.

questions.prompt: Clean the carpet, please.
questions.answer: I don't need to clean the carpet. It has already been cleaned.

questions.prompt: Wash the dishes, please.
questions.answer: I don't need to wash the dishes. They have already been washed.

questions.prompt: Dust the table, please.
questions.answer: I don't need to dust the table. It has already been dusted.

questions.prompt: Water the flowers, please.
questions.answer: I don't need to water the flowers. They have already been watered.

questions.prompt: Make some coffee, please.
questions.answer: I don't need to make any coffee. It has already been made.

questions.prompt: Type the letters, please.
questions.answer: I don't need to type the letters. They have already been typed.

questions.prompt: Put the newspapers on the shelf, please.
questions.answer: I don't need to put the newspapers on the shelf. They have already been put there/on the shelf.

questions.prompt: Open the windows, please.
questions.answer: I don't need to open the windows. They have already been opened.
